rows.text: At the base of Epos' precipice, the maddened Titankin and monsters relentlessly pursue you from behind.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The collapsed bastion cuts the valley in half. From the statue's faded edges, they faintly reveal that it once belonged to a city that worshiped the Gate of Infinity.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You weave through the dilapidated ruins, attempting to navigate your way through shattered statues and altars, but a massive mirror on the stone wall blocks your way: "Those who enter must carry with them a thread of hope."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You have no time to ponder on the mirror's admonition. Muttering Janus' revered name under your breath, you dive into the mirror headfirst.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Float in the direction of the noise.
Cause the Stone Mirror to gain the effect: Trigger when entering Combat or Occurrence domains
Float in the direction of silence.
Cause the Stone Mirror to gain the effect: Trigger when entering Encounter or Reward domains
Proceed toward the direction with the prophecy.
